limits: Open-ended reasoning and factual recall are weak in models under 2B parameters.
Prompt processing in WebAssembly is slow: long prompts cost seconds before the first word. Keep prompts short.

A phone opening this over plain http on a LAN has no secure context, and then the app does not start at all: the engine finds no storage backend (measured, not assumed). Use HTTPS, or `adb reverse` and open http://localhost.
Inside the Android app the system WebView never becomes cross-origin isolated, so the model runs single-threaded with no WebGPU. That is an Android WebView limitation, not a setting we can change.
